author: TotallyBeast
body: Hello there Avicus Network Staff, I belive I was banned for ban evading _HyperShock_. I know it has been 10 months and it seems like I do not care, but I miss this server. I love the players, the staff, the maps, everything! I would like to be unbanned and given a second chance. I spent a lifetime diamond rank on this server and I would like to put it to good use! I did not buy it to get banned. I am extremely sorry for ban evading _HyperShock_. I will never ban evade anyone again, and if I do you can ban me and I will never ask again to be unbanned. But all I ask is to have a second chance. I truley miss this server and I would do<u> anything </u>to join again. Sincerly- TotallyBeast (Beast09)
